svg.aria-label: Relative leakage into the protected direction at step 60 for three LoRA arms on 15 models, and leakage trajectories over 60 AdamW steps, both on a log10 axis
svg.text: FIGURE · PROJECT-THEN-HEAL VS ADAMW · 15 MODELS (0.8B TO 32.8B) · H100 STAGE-1
Gradient projection leaks 0.33% to 1.67% after AdamW; ProjectThenHealLinear stays near 1e-10
Relative leakage ||D ΔW||_F / ||ΔW||_F of the LoRA writer update into the protected direction D, one metric for all three arms, log10 axis. 60 AdamW steps from a common
initialization on the surgically edited writer, synthetic target orthogonal to span(D) plus real-token cross-entropy (weight 0.1), one seed per model.
Step 60 ranges over 15 models: A 0.82% to 8.51%, B 0.33% to 1.67%, C 1.78e-10 to 8.67e-10. B / C ratio (labels) 6.5e+06 to 3.8e+07. Points below 1e-11 drawn at the axis floor: 0.

Local writer-update constraint only; it does not bound later layers or storage rounding. Source: irrefutable-15models-stage1-receipt.json, sha256 00f4fe2a...056f (identical for the 14 models it shares with the public-benchmark receipt).
